“Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs…
him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men…
He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’
There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be…
The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.
The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,
For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”
translations.bsb: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”
translations.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
translations.asv: Let all the house of Israel therefore know assuredly, that God hath made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom ye crucified.
